answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Salt carrier evaporation tray warrant countersigned by the evaporation register — each evaporation tray is a year of evaporation logs in the salt ledger, so a farm. The farm's budget must cover 704 proofs at 116 POA each — 81664 POA — before any reward is even possible. The crystal is checked once, the cipher is charged once, and the reef is read every epoch after. The record is public, the price is fixed, and the farm cannot negotiate either.
